notes_for_editor: Thin record: two listings, both one line on the cab. Nothing found on staffing, fires, removal date or present condition, so the story says only that no source describes the site today. Not the same site as Old Baldy (Okanogan County; 1934 L-4 cab destroyed 1953 per Willhite's Old Baldy page) or Bald Mountain (Kittitas County, US 1355; 1931 tower replaced 1955). The brief had no build event; the 1931 build was added from both listings. Leads not yet tried: Wenatchee National Forest records and Chelan Valley newspapers. A Forest Service museum photo titled Baldy Mountain Lookout (2019.040.034) appeared in search results but was not opened.
